sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 在2011年，加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园里发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，并且体内血液已被排空。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来她的凶手费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是“档案档案呈献”的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: It was nearing 4.30 on the cold, misty morning of Saturday, August 28, 1993, when married couple Ted and Jan Warner were jolted awake by a loud knock on their front door.
sentences.zh: 那是1993年8月28日星期六一个寒冷多雾的早晨，接近4点30分，已婚夫妇特德和简·华纳被前门的一阵急促敲门声惊醒。

sentences.en: The Warners lived on Prince Edward Park Road, a quiet and leafy residential street in the southern Sydney suburb of Warranora.
sentences.zh: 华纳夫妇住在沃兰诺拉悉尼南部郊区一条安静绿树成荫的住宅街道爱德华王子公园路上。

sentences.en: Set on the waterfront of the Warranora River and surrounded by bushland, it was highly unusual to hear a disturbance at such an hour.
sentences.zh: 这里位于沃兰诺拉河的水滨，四周环绕着灌木丛，在这个时间听到骚乱是极不寻常的。

sentences.en: Ted got up to open the door and was surprised to find his neighbour,
sentences.zh: 特德起身去开门，惊讶地发现他的邻居，

sentences.en: 23-year-old Jeffrey Gillam, standing there, dressed in nothing but a pair of boxer shorts and smelling of smoke.
sentences.zh: 23岁的杰弗里·吉拉姆站在那里，身上只穿着一条平角短裤，散发着烟味。

sentences.en: Jeffrey lived next door to the Warners with his older brother, 25-year-old Christopher, and to their parents, Helen and Stephen.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里与华纳夫妇毗邻而居，同住的还有他25岁的哥哥克里斯托弗以及他们的父母海伦和斯蒂芬。

sentences.en: The Gillams were a fixture of Prince Edward Park Road, having lived in the neighbourhood for over two decades.
sentences.zh: 吉拉姆一家是爱德华王子公园路的常客，在这个社区生活了二十多年。

sentences.en: They were well-liked, with locals viewing them as a loving, warm and sociable family, always keen to lend a hand to those in need,
sentences.zh: 他们很受欢迎，当地人认为他们是一个充满爱心、热情和善于社交的家庭，总是乐于向需要帮助的人伸出援手，

sentences.en: or bring a plate of food to the neighbourhood barbecues.
sentences.zh: 或者在社区烧烤活动中带上一盘食物。

sentences.en: Ted had known Jeffrey Gillam his whole life and had never seen him in such a state.
sentences.zh: 特德认识杰弗里·吉拉姆一辈子了，从未见过他这般模样。

sentences.en: Typically neatly presented and well-spoken, his pale skin was covered in goosebumps and he appeared to be highly agitated.
sentences.zh: 他通常穿着整洁、谈吐得体，苍白的皮肤上起满了鸡皮疙瘩，显得异常情绪激动。

sentences.en: He started speaking in a strange, disjointed fashion, asking Ted to call triple zero.
sentences.zh: 他开始用一种奇怪、语无伦次的方式说话，要求特德拨打三个零。

sentences.en: They're all dead, Jeffrey mumbled.
sentences.zh: “他们都死了，”杰弗里嘟囔着。

sentences.en: He's killed them, set them on fire.
sentences.zh: “他杀了他们，还放火烧了他们。”

sentences.en: Ted was stunned as he tried to make sense of Jeffrey's semi-gibberish claiMs.
sentences.zh: 特德惊呆了，试图理解杰弗里那些半懂不懂的胡言乱语。

sentences.en: Mum and Dad are both dead, Jeffrey continued.
sentences.zh: “爸爸妈妈都死了，”杰弗里继续说道。

sentences.en: He's burned them.
sentences.zh: “他烧了他们。”

sentences.en: I've killed him for what he did.
sentences.zh: “我为了他所做的事杀了他。”

sentences.en: Ted ushered Jeffrey into his house and dialed triple zero.
sentences.zh: 特德把杰弗里迎进屋里并拨打了三个零。

sentences.en: As Ted tried to explain to the operator what was going on, the operator asked if Jeffrey had been drinking.
sentences.zh: 正当特德试图向接线员解释发生的事情时，接线员询问杰弗里是否喝过酒。

sentences.en: Ted lent over to smell Jeffrey's breath, noting that it didn't smell like alcohol, but kerosene.
sentences.zh: 特德俯身闻了闻杰弗里的呼吸，发现没有酒味，而是煤油味。

sentences.en: He handed the phone to Jeffrey so he could explain things for himself.
sentences.zh: 他把电话递给杰弗里，让他自己解释情况。

sentences.en: In a halting and distracted manner,
sentences.zh: 以一种断断续续、心神不定地方式，

sentences.en: Jeffrey told the operator that his brother Christopher had killed his parents, and set their bodies on fire.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里告诉接线员，他的哥哥克里斯托弗杀害了他们的父母，并点燃了他们的尸体。

sentences.en: He said that he'd chased Christopher down the stairs and killed him for what he did.
sentences.zh: 他说他一路追着克里斯托弗下楼，并因他所做的事杀了他。

sentences.en: He killed them.
sentences.zh: “他杀了他们。”

sentences.en: Killed them.
sentences.zh: “杀了他们。”

sentences.en: Jeffrey stammered.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里结结巴巴地说。

sentences.en: I don't know why.
sentences.zh: “我不知道为什么。”

sentences.en: Like most of the other homes in the area, the Gillums lived on a long, narrow block that sloped downwards from Prince Edward Park Road and towards the riverfront.
sentences.zh: 就像该地区的其他大多数房屋一样，吉拉姆一家住在一栋长而窄的地块上，地块从爱德华王子公园路向河滨方向倾斜向下。

sentences.en: External stairs led down from the street and to their modest two-storey home, which was surrounded by an assortment of towering trees and greenery.
sentences.zh: 室外楼梯从街道通往他们简朴的两层住宅，周围环绕着各种高耸的树木和绿树。

sentences.en: The upper floor consisted of the combined lounge, dining and kitchen space, which gave way to Stephen and Helen's bedroom.
sentences.zh: 上层由起居室、餐厅和厨房组成，通往斯蒂芬和海伦的卧室。

sentences.en: From the lounge room, a spiral staircase led to the downstairs bedroom belonging to Christopher, which had an adjoining en suite and rumpus room.
sentences.zh: 从休息室出发，旋转楼梯通往属于克里斯托弗的楼下卧室，该卧室设有相连的套间浴室和活动室。

sentences.en: Jeffrey lived in the converted boat shed, which was attached to the main house by a set of external stairs.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里住在改造过的小船棚里，通过一套室外楼梯与主屋相连。

sentences.en: At 4.43am, a team of firefighters arrived at the property to find smoke rising from the roof.
sentences.zh: 凌晨4点43分，一队消防员抵达该物业，发现屋顶冒出浓烟。

sentences.en: Jeffrey Gillum was waiting for them at the bottom of the external stairs, in a highly agitated and emotionally distraught state.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里·吉拉姆在室外楼梯底部等待着他们，处于高度激动和情绪崩溃的状态。

sentences.en: He appeared to be disoriented and delirious, speaking incoherently about his parents being dead inside the house.
sentences.zh: 他显得神情迷惘、语无伦次，颠三倒四地谈论着他的父母死在屋里。

sentences.en: The firefighters ran along the side balcony to the rear of their house.
sentences.zh: 消防员沿着侧阳台跑向房屋后方。

sentences.en: Flames roared from inside Helen and Stephen's bedroom, as well as from a second fire in the lounge room.
sentences.zh: 海伦和斯蒂芬卧室内部以及起居室的第二处火灾正腾起熊熊烈火。

sentences.en: The firefighters opened the sliding glass doors that led to the upper living space, but were met with a wave of heat so extreme that they couldn't enter.
sentences.zh: 消防员打开通往上层生活空间的推拉玻璃门，却迎面遭遇一股极端的高温，根本无法进入。

sentences.en: Then, the window from Helen and Stephen's bedroom shattered, shooting flames outside.
sentences.zh: 随后，海伦和斯蒂芬卧室的窗户碎裂，火苗喷射到室外。

sentences.en: Within minutes, the team was able to get the flames under control.
sentences.zh: 几分钟之内，搜救队就控制住了火势。

sentences.en: One of the firefighters entered the smoke-filled lounge room and found Helen's badly burnt body lying face down in the southern corner near the front door.
sentences.zh: 一名消防员进入烟雾弥漫的起居室，发现海伦严重烧伤的尸体面朝下躺在靠近前门的南部角落。

sentences.en: She had been stabbed 17 times, with 13 of the wounds to the front of her cheSt.
sentences.zh: 她被刺了17刀，其中13处伤口在前胸。

sentences.en: The firefighter continued into the bedroom, fighting flames as he went.
sentences.zh: 消防员继续走进卧室，一边推进一边扑灭火焰。

sentences.en: There, on the bedroom floor, he found Stephen's body lying face down.
sentences.zh: 在那里，他发现斯蒂芬的尸体面朝下躺在卧室地板上。

sentences.en: He had sustained a total of 28 wounds, 16 of which were to the front of his cheSt.
sentences.zh: 他总共受了28处伤，其中16处在前胸。

sentences.en: Parallel to the bed was an axe.
sentences.zh: 床平行放着一把斧头。

sentences.en: Police officers arrived at the scene and accompanied firefighters as they kicked in the door to the downstairs rumpers' room.
sentences.zh: 警察赶到现场并陪同消防员踢开通往楼下娱乐室的门。

sentences.en: The area was dark except for the reflected light of a spot fire that continued to blaze upstairs.
sentences.zh: 该区域一片漆黑，只有楼上仍在熊熊燃烧的局部火灾的反射光。

sentences.en: There, they found Christopher Gillum's body lying next to the billiard table, naked except for a toweling dressing gown.
sentences.zh: 在那里，他们发现克里斯托弗·吉拉姆的尸体躺在台球桌旁，除了毛巾浴袍外全身赤裸。

sentences.en: His body was unaffected by the fire, but riddled with stab wounds.
sentences.zh: 他的尸体未受火灾影响，但布满了刺伤。

sentences.en: Like his mother, he'd been stabbed 17 times, a majority of the wounds to his upper cheSt.
sentences.zh: 像他的母亲一样，他被刺了17刀，大部分伤口在上胸部。

sentences.en: Next to his body lay a knife.
sentences.zh: 他的尸体旁放着一把刀。

sentences.en: After being examined by paramedics at the scene, Geoffrey Gillum was taken to Sutherland Police Station,
sentences.zh: 在现场接受紧急医疗人员检查后，杰弗里·吉拉姆被带到萨瑟兰警察局，

sentences.en: where at 8.22am, he agreed to participate in an electronically recorded interview.
sentences.zh: 上午8点22分，他同意参与一项有电子记录的访谈。

sentences.en: The traumatic events of the morning had clearly taken their toll on the 23-year-old.
sentences.zh: 清晨经历的创伤事件显然给这位23岁的年轻人带来了沉重的打击。

sentences.en: He sat wrapped in a blanket with a somewhat bewildered look on his face.
sentences.zh: 他裹着毯子坐着，脸上带着一丝迷惑不解的表情。

sentences.en: His eyes cast downwards as he quietly mumbled brief answers to all of the officers' questions.
sentences.zh: 他双眼低垂，轻声嘟囔着回答警察的所有问题。

sentences.en: According to Geoffrey, the previous evening had been an ordinary Friday.
sentences.zh: 据杰弗里回忆，前一天晚上是一个普通的周五。

sentences.en: His girlfriend Hayley had come over for dinner, leaving at around 10pm.
sentences.zh: 他的女友海莉过来吃晚饭，大约晚上10点离开。

sentences.en: After that, he watched television with his parents in the lounge room before having a shower and then going to bed.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，他和父母在起居室看电视，然后洗个澡就去睡觉了。

sentences.en: He wasn't sure exactly what time this was, but thought it was sometime before midnight.
sentences.zh: 他不太确定具体时间，但认为是在午夜之前某个时候。

sentences.en: Geoffrey said he was fast asleep when suddenly he was awoken by the intercom that connected the boat shed with the main house.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里说他睡得很死，突然被连接船屋和主屋的对讲机吵醒。

sentences.en: It was his mother, Helen, screaming for help.
sentences.zh: 那是他的母亲海伦，大声呼救。

sentences.en: Geoffrey couldn't understand anything she was saying, but he wasted no time thinking about it.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里听不懂她在说什么，但他没有浪费时间去思考。

sentences.en: He quickly pulled on a pair of boxer shorts and raced through the garden to the staircase that led to the sliding glass doors upstairs.
sentences.zh: 他迅速套上一条平角短裤，穿过花园冲向通往楼上推拉玻璃门的楼梯。

sentences.en: This took him less than a minute.
sentences.zh: 这花了他不到一分钟的时间。

sentences.en: He unlocked the door and ran into the lounge room.
sentences.zh: 他打开门锁跑进起居室。

sentences.en: There, he found his mother's body lying near the front door.
sentences.zh: 在那里，他发现母亲的尸体躺在前门附近。

sentences.en: A knife was on the floor nearby next to the piano and his brother Christopher was standing over her with a match in his hand.
sentences.zh: 附近钢琴旁的地板上有一把刀，他的哥哥克里斯托弗手里拿着一根火柴站在她上方。

sentences.en: Christopher looked at Geoffrey from across the room and said, With that, Geoffrey claimed that Christopher set Helen's body on fire.
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗隔着房间看着杰弗里说：随后，杰弗里声称克里斯托弗点燃了海伦的尸体。

sentences.en: As the flames quickly started spreading, Geoffrey looked towards the bedroom and saw his father's Stephen's body on the floor.
sentences.zh: 随着火势迅速蔓延，杰弗里看向卧室，看到他父亲斯蒂芬的尸体躺在地板上。

sentences.en: Within seconds, the fire reached the bedroom and set Stephen's body ablaze.
sentences.zh: 几秒钟之内，大火烧到卧室，将斯蒂芬的尸体付之一炬。

sentences.en: Unable to believe what he was seeing, an overwhelming feeling overcame Geoffrey.
sentences.zh: 无法相信自己所看到的，一种压倒性的情绪涌上杰弗里心头。

sentences.en: All he could think was that he had to get his brother.
sentences.zh: 他脑子里只想抓住他哥哥。

sentences.en: He grabbed the knife from the floor and lunged towards him.
sentences.zh: 他抓起地上的刀冲了过去。

sentences.en: Christopher turned and ran down the spiral staircase, with Geoffrey chasing behind.
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗转身跑下旋转楼梯，杰弗里在后面紧追不舍。

sentences.en: Everything from there was a bit of a haze.
sentences.zh: 从那以后的一切都有些迷糊。

sentences.en: Geoffrey didn't know if he first stabbed Christopher while they were on the stairs or once they reached the bottom,
sentences.zh: 杰弗里不知道他们是在楼梯上时还是到达底部时第一次刺伤克里斯托弗，

sentences.en: but by the time they were in the rumpus room, Geoffrey had him cornered.
sentences.zh: 但当他们到达娱乐室时，杰弗里已经把他逼入了死角。

sentences.en: He launched towards Christopher and began stabbing him repeatedly.
sentences.zh: 他扑向克里斯托弗，开始反复刺他。

sentences.en: Christopher fell to the floor as Geoffrey continued to strike him.
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗倒在地板上，杰弗里继续攻击他。

sentences.en: He didn't know how many times he stabbed his brother or what he did with the knife afterwards, but he eventually ran back up the stairs.
sentences.zh: 他不知道自己刺了哥哥多少次，也不知道事后怎么处理这把刀，但他最终跑回了楼上。

sentences.en: By then, the fire had spread throughout the lounge room and the air was thick with smoke.
sentences.zh: 那时，大火已蔓延至整个起居室，空气中浓烟滚滚。

sentences.en: Geoffrey raced out the sliding doors and to the Warners' home next door to raise the alarm.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里冲出推拉门，跑到隔壁华纳的家报警。

sentences.en: As word of what happened spread around Waranora, those who knew the Gillam family were left in complete shock.
sentences.zh: 随着事情的传闻在瓦拉诺拉传开，认识吉拉姆一家的人都陷入了极度的震惊之中。

sentences.en: To the outside world, they had always appeared to be a completely normal, stable family.
sentences.zh: 在外界看来，他们一直是一个完全正常、稳定的家庭。

sentences.en: 58-year-old Stephen Gillam was a cheerful and easygoing bloke.
sentences.zh: 58岁的斯蒂芬·吉拉姆是一个开朗随和的家伙。

sentences.en: He'd recently retired after decades working for the New South Wales Roads and Traffic Authority
sentences.zh: 他在为新南威尔士州道路和交通管理局工作了几十年后最近退休了，

sentences.en: and spent his spare time sailing, playing golf and working casually at the local boat shed.
sentences.zh: 闲暇时间用来航海、打高尔夫球并在当地的小船棚打零工。

sentences.en: His wife, 55-year-old Helen, worked as a school nurse with the Southern Sydney Health Service.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子，55岁的海伦，在南悉尼健康服务部担任学校护士。

sentences.en: She was the more serious of the pair, known for her no-nonsense attitude when it came to raising her two sons, but she also enjoyed a good laugh and was fun to be around.
sentences.zh: 她是两人中比较严肃的一个，在抚养两个儿子时以务实的态度著称，但她也喜欢开怀大笑，为人风趣。

sentences.en: Stephen and Helen loved their two boys and had worked hard to give them a solid upbringing.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬和海伦深爱着他们的两个男孩，并努力为他们提供坚实的成长环境。

sentences.en: Life on the Waranora River meant that Stephen was able to share his passion for sailing with his children.
sentences.zh: 沃兰诺拉河畔的生活意味着斯蒂芬能够与孩子们分享他对航海的热情。

sentences.en: It was through their shared love of boats that Stephen and Geoffrey established a particularly close bond.
sentences.zh: 正是在对船只的共同热爱中，斯蒂芬和杰弗里建立了特别亲密的关系。

sentences.en: They spent a majority of their weekends out on the water, honing Geoffrey's sailing skills for competition.
sentences.zh: 他们大部分周末都在水上度过，磨练杰弗里的航海技能以备参赛。

sentences.en: Such was his talent that he'd once won a national championship.
sentences.zh: 他的天赋如此之高，以至于曾经赢得过全国冠军。

sentences.en: When he wasn't out sailing, Geoffrey spent his time surfing, socialising with friends and studying for his civil engineering degree.
sentences.zh: 不航海的时候，杰弗里把时间花在冲浪、与朋友社交以及攻读土木工程学位上。

sentences.en: He only had six months left before he was set to graduate, and the future was looking bright.
sentences.zh: 他离毕业只有六个月了，未来一片光明。

sentences.en: While Geoffrey was known to be light-hearted and easygoing like his father, Christopher Gillam was more shy and reserved.
sentences.zh: 虽然杰弗里像他父亲一样性格开朗随和，但克里斯托弗·吉拉姆则更加害羞内向。

sentences.en: He often joined his family on their boating adventures, but seemed happier to just hang around in the background.
sentences.zh: 他经常和家人一起参加划船冒险，但似乎更愿意在背景里闲逛。

sentences.en: Christopher's passions lay elsewhere, in fencing, computers and piano.
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗的爱好在别处，在击剑、电脑和钢琴上。

sentences.en: He was such a talented pianist that neighbours often asked the Gillams to keep their windows open when Christopher was practising so they could hear him play.
sentences.zh: 他是一位非常有天赋的钢琴家，邻居们经常请吉拉姆一家在克里斯托弗练习时把窗户打开，这样他们就能听到他弹奏。

sentences.en: One uncle described the Gillam brothers as impressive young men who had been well brought up with old-fashioned, good values.
sentences.zh: 一位叔叔将吉拉姆兄弟描述为令人印象深刻的年轻人，他们受过良好教育，具有老式的良好价值观。

sentences.en: This made it all the more difficult for their friends and family to believe what had happened.
sentences.zh: 这使得他们的朋友和家人更加难以相信所发生的事情。

sentences.en: According to Geoffrey Gillam, that winter had been a bit rough on Christopher.
sentences.zh: 据杰弗里·吉拉姆说，那个冬天对克里斯托弗来说有点艰难。

sentences.en: Having completed a degree in chemical engineering the previous year, he was struggling to find a job in the wake of the recession that hit Australia in the early 1990s.
sentences.zh: 由于前一年获得了化学工程学位，他在20世纪90年代初席卷澳大利亚的经济衰退之后一直在努力寻找工作。

sentences.en: His parents had urged him to study a one-year teaching degree as backup, but Christopher wasn't particularly enjoying it and also had doubts about his future employment prospects.
sentences.zh: 他的父母曾敦促他攻读一年的教学学位作为后备，但克里斯托弗并不是特别喜欢，而且对未来的就业前景也有疑虑。

sentences.en: He'd done some practical teacher training at a tough Western Sydney high school and didn't feel particularly cut out for the role.
sentences.zh: 他在西悉尼的一所艰难的高中做过一些实际的教师培训，感觉自己不太适合这个角色。

sentences.en: To make matters worse, Christopher's girlfriend had recently broken up with him.
sentences.zh: 更糟糕的是，克里斯托弗的女朋友最近和他分手了。

sentences.en: He retreated further into himself, spending most of his time at home on the family's computer.
sentences.zh: 他进一步退缩到自己内心里，把大部分时间花在家里的电脑上。

sentences.en: Geoffrey claimed that in the weeks leading up to the murders, Christopher had been acting strangely.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里声称，在谋杀案发生前的几周里，克里斯托弗表现得很奇怪。

sentences.en: Tensions seemed to be boiling over between him and their father and they'd been arguing constantly.
sentences.zh: 他和父亲之间的紧张关系似乎在加剧，他们一直在争吵。

sentences.en: Geoffrey told his girlfriend Hayley that Christopher had lost it and that he'd been going off at their parents, throwing things and pushing and shoving their father.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里告诉他的女朋友海莉，克里斯托弗已经失控了，他一直在父母面前发脾气、扔东西、推搡父亲。

sentences.en: About two weeks before the murders, Hayley was on the phone to Geoffrey when she overheard an argument in the background.
sentences.zh: 在大约谋杀发生前两周，海莉正在和杰弗里通电话，无意中听到背景中的争吵声。

sentences.en: When she asked Geoffrey what they were fighting about, he responded,
sentences.zh: 当她问杰弗里他们在为什么争吵时，他回答说，

sentences.en: At around 5pm on the night before the murders, Geoffrey had gone to the beach with his close friend Wayne to check out the surfing conditions.
sentences.zh: 在谋杀案发生前一晚的大约下午5点，杰弗里和他的密友韦恩去海滩查看冲浪条件。

sentences.en: Geoffrey told Wayne that his brother had been acting strangely and had been going off at the drop of a hat.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里告诉韦恩，他的兄弟行为举止古怪，一触即发。

sentences.en: Wayne had known the brothers for several years and was shocked to hear that Christopher had been pushing and shoving Stephen Gillum.
sentences.zh: 韦恩认识这对兄弟好几年了，听到克里斯托弗一直在推搡斯蒂芬·吉拉姆，感到非常震惊。

sentences.en: He asked what the fighting was about.
sentences.zh: 他问他们在为什么争吵。

sentences.en: Geoffrey said he wasn't sure but he thought it could be over money given that Christopher wanted a new car.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里说他不太确定，但他认为这可能是因为钱，因为克里斯托弗想要一辆新车。

sentences.en: Geoffrey declined an invitation to watch a movie at Wayne's house that night.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里拒绝了那天晚上去韦恩家看电影的邀请。

sentences.en: He said his dad was due home from golf and he wanted to be there in case Christopher acted out again.
sentences.zh: 他说他爸爸要从高尔夫球场回家，他想留在那儿以防克里斯托弗再次发作。

sentences.en: When Geoffrey got home at around 8pm, his girlfriend Hayley was there, having arrived unannounced.
sentences.zh: 当杰弗里在晚上8点左右到家时，他的女朋友海莉已经在那里了，是不请自来的。

sentences.en: While she'd been waiting for Geoffrey, Hayley had briefly crossed paths with Christopher when he came out of the computer room to grab a coffee.
sentences.zh: 在等待杰弗里的同时，海莉在克里斯托弗从电脑房出来拿咖啡时与他有过短暂的交集。

sentences.en: While Hayley hadn't observed anything out of the ordinary, she thought she could sense some underlying tension between Christopher and his parents.
sentences.zh: 虽然海莉没有观察到任何异常，但她觉得克里斯托弗和他的父母之间存在某种潜在的紧张关系。

sentences.en: Geoffrey and Hayley ate dinner together and then played billiards before Geoffrey walked Hayley out to her car at around 10pm.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里和海莉一起吃晚饭，然后打台球，大约晚上10点杰弗里送海莉去她的车。

sentences.en: Again, he repeated his concerns about Christopher's behaviour.
sentences.zh: 他又一次重申了他对克里斯托弗行为的担忧。

sentences.en: In the bathroom attached to Christopher's bedroom, police found two empty packets of Panadol brand paracetamol in the clothes basket,
sentences.zh: 在克里斯托弗卧室旁边的浴室里，警察在衣篮里找到了两包空的必理痛品牌扑热息痛，

sentences.en: along with a 25mm syringe filled with a white paste, a glass cup with a white substance on it, and a knife containing the same white substance.
sentences.zh: 还有一个装有白色糊状物的25毫米注射器、一个上面沾有白色物质的玻璃杯以及一把沾有相同白色物质的刀。

sentences.en: Each of these items tested positive for paracetamol,
sentences.zh: 其中每件物品的对扑热息痛测试均呈阳性，

sentences.en: leading to the presumption that Christopher had likely prepared this high-dose mix of Panadol ahead of time with the intention of taking his own life.
sentences.zh: 从而推测克里斯托弗可能提前准备了这种大剂量的必理痛混合物，打算结束自己的生命。

sentences.en: What he hadn't accounted for was his mother calling Geoffrey for help on the intercom, thus foiling his plans as he died by his brother's hand instead of his own.
sentences.zh: 他没有料到的是他的母亲通过对讲机呼叫杰弗里寻求帮助，从而破坏了他的计划，使他死于他兄弟之手而不是他自己。

sentences.en: Post-mortem examinations of Stephen and Helen's bodies were unable to determine in which order the two had died or their times of death.
sentences.zh: 对斯蒂芬和海伦尸体的尸检无法确定两人死亡的先后顺序或死亡时间。

sentences.en: All pathologists could say for sure was that the stab wounds had been inflicted while the two were still alive and that they'd both died within minutes of being attacked.
sentences.zh: 所有病理学家能确定的是，刺伤是在两人还活着的时候造成的，并且两人在遭到袭击后几分钟内死亡。

sentences.en: Samples taken from the carpet of the upper floor of the Gillam's home tested positive for mineral turpentine or a similar flammable hydrocarbon liquid,
sentences.zh: 从吉拉姆家上层地毯取样的测试结果显示矿物松节油或类似的易燃碳氢化合物液体呈阳性，

sentences.en: indicating that Christopher had used an accelerant to start the fire.
sentences.zh: 表明克里斯托弗曾使用助燃剂来纵火。

sentences.en: Searches of the property didn't turn up any such containers, but given that mineral turpentine was sold in lightweight plastic bottles,
sentences.zh: 对该物业的搜查没有发现任何此类容器，但鉴于矿物松节油是用轻质塑料瓶出售的，

sentences.en: investigators reasoned that any evidence relating to this would have been readily consumed by the fire without leaving a trace.
sentences.zh: 调查人员推断，与此相关的任何证据都会轻易被大火吞噬而不留痕迹。

sentences.en: For the death of his brother, Geoffrey Gillam was charged with murder and denied bail.
sentences.zh: 因谋杀兄长，杰弗里·吉拉姆被控谋杀并被拒绝保释。

sentences.en: He spent a month in the psychiatric unit of Long Bay Jail as he struggled to accept the magnitude of the situation.
sentences.zh: 他在朗湾监狱的精神科度过了一个月，努力接受这一巨大变故。

sentences.en: Friends and family rallied around him, providing whatever support they could to get him through this tragic time.
sentences.zh: 亲朋好友聚集在他身边，为他提供力所能及的支持，帮助他度过这段悲惨的时期。

sentences.en: Geoffrey was eventually granted bail on the condition that he undergo psychological counselling and move in with a family friend who had been supporting him since his arreSt.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里最终获得保释，条件是接受心理辅导，并搬去与一位自他被捕以来一直支持他的家族朋友同住。

sentences.en: He faced trial for Christopher's murder in April 1995, where he pleaded guilty to the lesser charge of manslaughter.
sentences.zh: 1995年4月，他因涉嫌谋杀克里斯托弗而出庭受审，并在庭上对较轻的过失杀人罪名表示认罪。

sentences.en: Two psychologists found that Geoffrey suffered from no ongoing mental disorder, psychiatric condition or violent tendencies.
sentences.zh: 两位心理学家发现，杰弗里并未患有任何持续的精神障碍、精神病状况或暴力倾向。

sentences.en: He'd simply reacted, albeit in a very extreme manner, to the circumstances he was presented with at the time.
sentences.zh: 他只是对当时所处的环境做出了反应，尽管这种反应极其极端。

sentences.en: They were both of the view that there was minimal risk of Geoffrey offending again, that he showed deep remorse, and that his prospects for rehabilitation were excellent.
sentences.zh: 他们一致认为，杰弗里再次犯罪的风险极小，他表现出深深的悔意，且其改过自新的前景极佳。

sentences.en: The Crown accepted Geoffrey's manslaughter plea and he was sentenced to a five-year good behaviour bond, with the judge describing the whole situation as a remarkable human drama.
sentences.zh: 检方接受了杰弗里关于过失杀人的认罪，并判处他五年行为良好保证令，法官将整个事件形容为一场非凡的人间戏剧。

sentences.en: Two months later, a coronial inquest was held to formally solidify the circumstances of Helen and Stephen's deaths.
sentences.zh: 两个月后，当局举行了一场验尸研讯，以正式确认海伦和斯蒂芬死亡的具体情节。

sentences.en: The coroner found that the couple had died by stab wounds inflicted by their son Christopher, and the case was officially closed.
sentences.zh: 验尸官裁定，两人死于其儿子克里斯托弗造成的刺伤，案件随即正式结案。

sentences.en: Geoffrey Gillam did his best to move on with his life, focusing on one small task at a time.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里·吉拉姆尽最大努力继续生活，专注于一次完成一件小事。

sentences.en: He completed his engineering degree with honours and secured a stable job.
sentences.zh: 他以优异成绩完成了工程学学位，并找到了一份稳定的工作。

sentences.en: His relationship with Hayley ended, and he started dating a friend of his from university named Rebecca.
sentences.zh: 他与海莉的关系走到了尽头，并开始与一位名叫丽贝卡的大学女性朋友交往。

sentences.en: The two developed a deep bond and began making plans for their future together, with a house, marriage and children on the horizon.
sentences.zh: 两人发展出了深厚的感情，并开始规划他们的共同未来，买房、结婚和孩子都在计划之中。

sentences.en: After everything Geoffrey had been through, he worked hard to create the life he'd always envisioned for himself prior to the tragedy.
sentences.zh: 经历了这一切后，杰弗里努力去创造他在悲剧发生前一直为自己设想的生活。

sentences.en: Many admired the way in which he was able to pick himself up and carry on.
sentences.zh: 许多人都佩戴赞赏他能够重新振作并继续前行的能力。

sentences.en: But for Geoffrey's paternal uncle, Tony Gillam, things weren't sitting right.
sentences.zh: 但对于杰弗里的叔父托尼·吉拉姆来说，事情却显得有些不对劲。

sentences.en: Ever since the funerals of Stephen, Helen and Christopher, Tony Gillam had felt like something was a little off.
sentences.zh: 自从斯蒂芬、海伦和克里斯托弗的葬礼以来，托尼·吉拉姆就一直觉得哪里有些不对劲。

sentences.en: He'd watched Geoffrey during the funerals and was surprised to see that he hadn't shed any tears.
sentences.zh: 他在葬礼期间注意到了杰弗里，惊讶地发现他竟然没有流下一滴眼泪。

sentences.en: Even the sight of his family's coffins hadn't sparked any visible emotion.
sentences.zh: 甚至看到家人的棺材也未能激起他任何可见的情绪。

sentences.en: Tony had been in such a state of shock after the murders that he had taken half a year off work.
sentences.zh: 谋杀案发生后，托尼陷入了极度的震惊之中，以至于他请了半年假停职休养。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, he felt like Geoffrey was carrying on as though he was unaffected, completing his university degree so quickly and with flying colours.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他觉得杰弗里表现得像个没事人一样，如此迅速且优异地完成了大学学业。

sentences.en: When it took Geoffrey six months to collect his family's ashes, Tony started to get really suspicious.
sentences.zh: 当杰弗里花了足足六个月才去领取家人的骨灰时，托尼开始产生真正的怀疑。

sentences.en: Tony found the allegations that Christopher had killed his parents over disputes about money to be completely without logic.
sentences.zh: 托尼认为克里斯托弗因金钱纠纷而杀死父母的指控完全不符合逻辑。

sentences.en: Although Tony lived interstate and didn't visit his half-brother and his family often,
sentences.zh: 尽管托尼住在其他州，不常去探望他同父异母的兄弟及其家人，

sentences.en: he had caught up with Stephen and Helen just six months before the murders and everything had seemed perfectly fine.
sentences.zh: 但在谋杀案发生前仅仅六个月，他还和斯蒂芬与海伦聚过面，当时一切看起来都非常完美。

sentences.en: If there had been tensions between them and their eldest son, they certainly hadn't shown it.
sentences.zh: 如果他们和长子之间存在紧张关系，他们绝对没有表现出来。

sentences.en: Tony was also a bit taken aback by Geoffrey's claims that Christopher was the more shy and withdrawn member of the family.
sentences.zh: 对于杰弗里声称克里斯托弗是家中更为害羞和孤僻的人的说法，托尼也感到有些错愕。

sentences.en: As far as Tony was concerned, it was Geoffrey who had always been the aloof one, whereas he'd always found Christopher to be friendly and talkative.
sentences.zh: 在托尼看来，一直以来冷漠的人分明是杰弗里，而克里斯托弗在他眼里一直是个友好且健谈的人。

sentences.en: If anything, Tony thought that Geoffrey was jealous of the extra care Christopher received from their parents and could be a bit of a bully.
sentences.zh: 非要说的话，托尼认为杰弗里一直在嫉妒父母给予克里斯托弗的额外关爱，并且有点爱欺负人。

sentences.en: When the crime scene was examined, investigators had found a 25-litre jerry can containing roughly one litre of petrol
sentences.zh: 当调查人员勘察犯罪现场时，在屋前存放垃圾桶的小凹室里

sentences.en: in the small alcove at the front of the house where the bins were kept.
sentences.zh: 发现了一个装有约一升汽油的25升塑料油桶。

sentences.en: There was also a freshly cut length of garden hose, which appeared to have been cut from a longer hose that ran from an outdoor tap to a boat in the carport.
sentences.zh: 此外还有一截新剪断的花园软管，这截软管似乎是从一根连接着户外水龙头到车棚里小船的长软管上剪下来的。

sentences.en: Geoffrey explained that on the night before the murders, he and his father had cut the hose in an attempt to siphon some petrol out of his car
sentences.zh: 杰弗里解释说，在谋杀案发生的前一晚，他和父亲曾剪断软管，试图从他的车里吸出一些汽油

sentences.en: to use in one of their motorboats for an upcoming trip.
sentences.zh: 以便在即将到来的旅行中用于其中一艘摩托艇。

sentences.en: They wanted to make two-stroke fuel, but then realised the car contained the wrong kind of petrol, so they aborted their mission and put the jerry can back near the bins.
sentences.zh: 他们本想制作二冲程燃油，但随后意识到汽车里的汽油标号不对，于是取消了计划，并将油桶放回了垃圾桶旁。

sentences.en: Tony found this hard to believe.
sentences.zh: 托尼觉得这很难令人信服。

sentences.en: Not only was it likely that Stephen Gillum would have the proper equipment needed to pump petrol without having to use this crude method,
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬·吉拉姆不仅很可能拥有抽取汽油所需的专业设备，根本无需使用这种粗糙的方法，

sentences.en: he had been scheduled to enter a golf tournament that Saturday.
sentences.zh: 而且他原本计划在那个星期六参加一场高尔夫比赛。

sentences.en: If there was no sense of urgency to get the boat ready, why would the two be outside so late on a cold winter night undertaking such an arduous task?
sentences.zh: 如果根本没有迫切需要准备船只的理由，这父子俩又怎么会在一个寒冷的冬夜这么晚还待在室外进行如此费力的任务呢？

sentences.en: A thought began to form in Tony's mind.
sentences.zh: 一个念头开始在托尼脑海中成形。

sentences.en: Was it possible that Geoffrey was actually responsible for all three deaths and had created the story of his brother's so-called psycho behaviour
sentences.zh: 有没有可能，杰弗里实际上才是这三条人命的罪魁祸首，而他编造了其兄弟所谓精神病行为的故事

sentences.en: to set Christopher up for the crime?
sentences.zh: 是为了将罪名嫁祸给克里斯托弗？

sentences.en: Tony wasn't the only one who felt this way.
sentences.zh: 有这种想法的不止托尼一人。

sentences.en: Ted and Jan Warner, the couple who lived next door to the Gillums, had been suspicious of Geoffrey's story ever since he knocked on their door on the morning of the murders.
sentences.zh: 泰德和简·华纳夫妇是吉拉姆一家的邻居，自从谋杀案当天早晨杰弗里敲响他们的门以来，他们就一直对杰弗里的说法抱有怀疑。

sentences.en: Despite claiming to have just stabbed his brother to death, there didn't appear to be any blood on him.
sentences.zh: 尽管杰弗里声称自己刚刚亲手捅死了亲兄弟，但他的身上似乎看不到任何血迹。

sentences.en: Ted had looked to Geoffrey up and down and the only blood he'd seen was on the little toe of Geoffrey's right foot and the shin of his left leg.
sentences.zh: 泰德上下打量过杰弗里，他唯一看到的血迹是在杰弗里右脚的小脚趾和左腿的胫骨上。

sentences.en: There was also a spot of blood on one of his fingernails.
sentences.zh: 其中一个指甲上也有一小点血迹。

sentences.en: Jan had noticed this too.
sentences.zh: 简也注意到了这一点。

sentences.en: In her view, the blood on Geoffrey's legs looked pale pink in colour, as though he had tried to wash it off.
sentences.zh: 在她看来，杰弗里腿上的血迹呈浅粉色，看起来就像是试图清洗过一样。

sentences.en: While Geoffrey had been at the Warner's home waiting for the firefighters to arrive, he'd switched between sitting on their light-coloured leather couch
sentences.zh: 当杰弗里待在华纳夫妇家中等待消防员赶到时，他一会儿坐在他们浅色的皮沙发上，

sentences.en: and lying on their kitchen floor in the fetal position.
sentences.zh: 一会儿又以胎儿的姿势躺在他们的厨房地板上。

sentences.en: Jan gave him a jumper to wear, but instead of putting it on, he just hugged it to his body.
sentences.zh: 简给了他一件套头衫穿，但他没有穿上，而是紧紧将它抱在怀里。

sentences.en: Afterwards, the Warners didn't notice any blood residue on the couch, floor, or their white-coloured telephone.
sentences.zh: 事后，华纳夫妇并没有在沙发、地板或他们白色的电话机上发现任何血迹残留。

sentences.en: After the police had taken Geoffrey in for questioning and cordoned off the house as a crime scene,
sentences.zh: 在警方将杰弗里带走盘问并封锁房屋作为犯罪现场之后，

sentences.en: Jan had turned to her husband and said, I think he's making it up.
sentences.zh: 简转过身对丈夫说：“我觉得他在胡编乱造。”

sentences.en: In 1996, after the coronial inquest had officially declared that Christopher was responsible for the deaths of Stephen and Helen,
sentences.zh: 1996年，在验尸研讯正式裁定克里斯托弗对斯蒂芬和海伦的死负有责任之后，

sentences.en: Geoffrey was able to apply for his share of the family's estate.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里得以申请分割家族遗产中属于他的那份份额。

sentences.en: He was only entitled to 50%, with his four grandparents entitled to the reSt.
sentences.zh: 他仅有权获得50%的遗产，其余部分则由他的四位祖父母继承。

sentences.en: Given everything that Geoffrey had been through, three of his grandparents wanted Geoffrey to have their share to help him rebuild his life.
sentences.zh: 鉴于杰弗里经历的一切，他的其中三位祖父母希望杰弗里能得到他们的那份份额，以帮助他重建生活。

sentences.en: However, Stephen's mother,
sentences.zh: 然而，斯蒂芬的母亲、

sentences.en: Geoffrey's grandmother,
sentences.zh: 杰弗里的祖母

sentences.en: Jessie Gillam, who lived in a house under Stephen's name, did not.
sentences.zh: 杰西·吉拉姆（她住在一处登记在斯蒂芬名下的房子里）却不同意。

sentences.en: Geoffrey sought further legal advice and discovered that he was actually entitled to 100% of his parents' estate.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里寻求了进一步的法律咨询，并发现他实际上有权继承父母100%的遗产。

sentences.en: This included their $900,000 home in Warranora, his father's boats, as well as Jessie's house in Mariong.
sentences.zh: 这包括他们在瓦拉诺拉价值90万澳元的住宅、他父亲的船只，以及杰西在马里翁的房子。

sentences.en: The paperwork was sent out to all of his grandparents to formally sign it over, but Jessie refused to do so.
sentences.zh: 相关文件被寄给所有的祖父母以正式签署转让，但杰西拒绝签字。

sentences.en: Jessie called her son,
sentences.zh: 杰西情绪激动地给她的儿子

sentences.en: Tony Gillam, in a state of distress, saying that Geoffrey was trying to harass her into signing her entitlements back to him.
sentences.zh: 托尼·吉拉姆打了电话，称杰弗里一直在纠缠她，逼迫她把属于她的继承权转让回给他。

sentences.en: It was at this point that Tony could no longer ignore the red flags.
sentences.zh: 正是在这个时候，托尼再也无法忽视那些危险信号了。

sentences.en: He flew to Sydney and visited the detective who had been in charge of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 他飞往悉尼，拜访了负责该案调查的侦探。

sentences.en: I've got my suspicions about Geoffrey,
sentences.zh: “我对杰弗里抱有怀疑，”

sentences.en: Tony said.
sentences.zh: 托尼说道。

sentences.en: What the detective told him next was shocking.
sentences.zh: 接下来侦探告诉他的话令人震惊。

sentences.zh: “案件档案”节目稍后回归。

sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商广告以支持我们。

sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持“案件档案”继续为您带来优质内容。

sentences.en: During the initial police interview with the Geoffrey Gillam on the morning of Saturday, August 28, 1993, the interviewing detectives weren't sure what to make of his account.
sentences.zh: 在1993年8月28日星期六早晨，警方对杰弗里·吉拉姆进行的首次讯问中，负责讯问的侦探们并不确定该如何看待他的说辞。

sentences.en: They had a hard time believing that two separate slayings could have occurred in the same household at around the same time.
sentences.zh: 他们很难相信在同一个家庭里会在大约同一时间发生两起独立的凶杀案。

sentences.en: If Geoffrey was capable of killing his brother, they thought it stood to reason that he could also be capable of killing his parents.
sentences.zh: 如果杰弗里有能力杀死他的兄弟，他们认为顺理成章的是，他同样有能力杀死他的父母。

sentences.en: They also thought it seemed highly strange that Geoffrey's first reaction upon seeing his parents' dead bodies had been to attack his brother, rather than check on his parents
sentences.zh: 他们还认为极其诡异的是，杰弗里看到父母尸体时的第一反应竟然是攻击兄弟，而不是去查看父母的情况

sentences.en: to confirm if they were actually dead or try to stop the fire.
sentences.zh: 以确认他们是否真的死亡，或者试图阻止火势。

sentences.en: One of the detectives put these questions to Geoffrey directly.
sentences.zh: 其中一位侦探直接向杰弗里提出了这些质问。

sentences.en: I don't know why I killed my brother, he responded.
sentences.zh: “我不知道我为什么要杀我兄弟，”他回答道。

sentences.en: I was just chasing him.
sentences.zh: “我当时只是在追他。”

sentences.en: I don't know why.
sentences.zh: “我不知道为什么。”

sentences.en: The detective pressed on.
sentences.zh: 侦探继续追问。

sentences.en: You're saying that your brother has killed your mother and father, and I'm just wondering whether it's just a convenient ploy on your behalf to tell us that,
sentences.zh: “你说你的兄弟杀害了你的父亲和母亲，我只是在想，这会不会只是你编造的一个方便的借口，

sentences.en: when in fact, you've killed the whole three of them.
sentences.zh: 而实际上，这三个人全都是你杀的。”

sentences.en: Geoffrey kept his eyes cast downwards and mumbled back.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里始终低垂着双眼，含糊不清地回应着。

sentences.en: I haven't.
sentences.zh: “我没有。”

sentences.en: He also couldn't explain why he hadn't checked on his dad or tried to stomp out the fire firSt.
sentences.zh: 他也无法解释为什么自己没有先去查看父亲的情况或者试图把火踩灭。

sentences.en: I don't know why, Geoffrey said.
sentences.zh: “我不知道为什么，”杰弗里说道。

sentences.en: I just thought of other things and just did the wrong thing, obviously.
sentences.zh: “我当时只是想到了别的事情，显然做错了事。”

sentences.en: During the interview, one of the detectives had also scribbled down a note for the other that read,
sentences.zh: 在讯问过程中，其中一位侦探还给另一位写了一张便条，上面写着：

sentences.en: If he's just stabbed his brother, where's the fucking blood?
sentences.zh: “如果他刚捅死他兄弟，他妈的血去哪了？”

sentences.en: Their suspicions grew upon hearing Geoffrey's explanation for the jerrycan of petrol with its makeshift siphon that was found in the Gillum's alcove.
sentences.zh: 当听到杰弗里对吉拉姆家凹室里发现的那个带有简易虹吸管的汽油桶的解释时，他们的怀疑进一步加深了。

sentences.en: To the detectives, it sounded like Geoffrey had been trying to use the petrol as an accelerant to start the fire with before finding it too hard
sentences.zh: 在侦探听来，这听起来像是杰弗里原本试图用汽油作为助燃剂来点火，但在发现实在太难点燃后，

sentences.en: and using mineral turpentine instead.
sentences.zh: 才转而使用矿物松节油替代。

sentences.en: They'd also been curious about the timing of the events.
sentences.zh: 他们对事件发生的时间也感到十分好奇。

sentences.en: A woman named Christine Shaw lived on the opposite side of the road to the Gillum's on a slope that overlooked their property.
sentences.zh: 一个名叫克里斯蒂娜·肖的女人住在吉拉姆家马路对面的一处斜坡上，俯瞰着他们的房产。

sentences.en: In the early morning hours of Saturday August 28, 1993,
sentences.zh: 在1993年8月28日星期六的清晨时分，

sentences.en: Christine had been reading in bed at around 3.45 when she heard the screams of two people.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜大约在3点45分正躺在床上看书，当时她听到了两个人的尖叫声。

sentences.en: One was a man making a guttural sound that reminded Christine of someone being struck by lightning.
sentences.zh: 其中一个是男人的声音，发出的喉音让克里斯蒂娜想起某人被雷击中的惨叫。

sentences.en: The other was a distressed-sounding woman who seemed to be desperately trying to reason with someone.
sentences.zh: 另一个是一个听起来很痛苦的女人声音，似乎在绝望地试图和某人讲道理。

sentences.en: Christine couldn't hear what was being said, but the voices alerted a neighbourhood dog who started barking incessantly.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜听不清具体在说些什么，但这些声音惊动了邻居家的狗，开始狂吠不止。

sentences.en: Eventually, at around 3.57am,
sentences.zh: 最终，在大约凌晨3点57分，

sentences.en: Christine went to the window to see what was going on, but by the time she got there, the voices stopped and she couldn't see anything.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜走到窗前查看外面发生了什么，但等她走到窗前时，声音已经停止了，她什么也看不见。

sentences.en: The dog continued to bark, waking its owners at some point between 4 and 4.15am.
sentences.zh: 狗仍在继续吠叫，并在凌晨4点到4点15分之间的某个时间吵醒了它的主人。

sentences.en: They got up to try and quiet him, but didn't hear any other voices.
sentences.zh: 他们起身试图让狗安静下来，但没有听到任何其他声音。

sentences.en: It was presumed that Christine Shaw had overheard Stephen Gillum in the throes of death and Helen Gillum defending herself against her attacker.
sentences.zh: 据推测，克里斯蒂娜·肖当时无意中听到的是斯蒂芬·吉拉姆在临死前的痛苦挣扎以及海伦·吉拉姆在反抗袭击者时的声音。

sentences.en: But if that was the case, it meant that they had both been attacked at around 4am.
sentences.zh: 但如果是这样的话，那就意味着两人都在凌晨4点左右受到了袭击。

sentences.en: Geoffrey claimed that upon hearing his mother's cries for help over the intercom, he'd immediately raced to the house, which took less than a minute, and everything had happened
sentences.zh: 杰弗里声称，通过内部对讲机听到母亲的呼救声后，他立刻冲向了房子，这不到一分钟，从那以后一切都发生得

sentences.en: very quickly from there.
sentences.zh: 非常快。

sentences.en: Why then, hadn't Geoffrey arrived at the Warner's house next door to raise the alarm until around 4.30am?
sentences.zh: 那么为什么直到大约凌晨4点30分，杰弗里才赶到隔壁华纳夫妇的家去报警？

sentences.en: What had he been doing for that unaccounted for period of around half an hour?
sentences.zh: 在这无法解释的约半小时时间里，他到底在干什么？

sentences.en: While all of these factors were dubious, it was when the autopsies came back that the detectives really started to question things.
sentences.zh: 虽然所有这些因素都令人起疑，但直到尸检报告出来后，侦探们才真正开始对种种疑点产生质疑。

sentences.en: Forensic examination had revealed that Stephen,
sentences.zh: 法医检验显示，斯蒂芬、

sentences.en: Helen and Christopher Gillum had all been stabbed a similar number of times, with a vast majority of the wounds concentrated on their chests and none on their abdomens.
sentences.zh: 海伦和克里斯蒂ショナル·吉拉姆（注：原文误植名，此处指克里斯托弗）身上被刺的次数相差无几，绝大多数伤口都集中在胸部，腹部没有任何伤口。

sentences.en: If there had been two separate killers, what were the chances that both had struck in such similar manners?
sentences.zh: 如果当时有两个不同的凶手，他们以如此相似的手法行凶的几率会有多大？

sentences.en: Testing was done of the blood found on Geoffrey's left shin and right hand to determine who the blood came from, but the samples weren't strong enough to make an identification.
sentences.zh: 技术人员对杰弗里左胫骨和右手发现的血迹进行了检测，以确定血样来源，但样本不够充分，无法辨别身份。

sentences.en: Then there was the knife, which, according to Geoffrey, had been used in all three of the killings.
sentences.zh: 还有那把凶器，根据杰弗里的说法，这把刀被用于全部三起谋杀案。

sentences.en: The knife had been tested for fingerprints, but none were found, nor was there any blood on the handle of the knife, nor the blade.
sentences.zh: 这把刀曾接受指纹检测，但没有发现任何指纹，刀柄或刀刃上也完全没有血迹。

sentences.en: There hadn't been any prints on the panadol-filled syringe or any of the other items in Christopher's laundry basket either.
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗洗衣篮里装有扑热息痛的注射器以及其他物品上也完全没有任何指纹。

sentences.en: Tony Gillum couldn't believe what he was hearing.
sentences.zh: 托尼·吉拉姆简直不敢相信自己的耳朵。

sentences.en: He asked the detective why they hadn't charged
sentences.zh: 他质问侦探，既然他们认为杰弗里有罪，

sentences.en: Geoffrey with Stephen and Helen's murders if they believed he was guilty.
sentences.zh: 为什么不以谋杀斯蒂芬和海伦的罪名起诉杰弗里。

sentences.en: The detective said that they had actually recommended that charges be laid, but the director of public prosecutions declined.
sentences.zh: 侦探表示，他们其实建议过提起公诉，但公共检察署署长拒绝了。

sentences.en: Tony refused to accept this.
sentences.zh: 托尼拒绝接受这个结果。

sentences.en: I'll sort that out, he said.
sentences.zh: “我会去把这事解决，”他说道。

sentences.en: After discussing the situation with his other brother,
sentences.zh: 在与自己的另一个兄弟商讨了这一情况后，

sentences.en: Tony rang Geoffrey and asked him to meet with them.
sentences.zh: 托尼给杰弗里打电话，要求与他们见面。

sentences.en: Geoffrey refused, questioning why and saying he wouldn't speak to anyone about the night of the killings without his solicitor present.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里拒绝了，反问原因并表示在没有律师在场的情况下，他不会跟任何人谈论谋杀案当晚的事情。

sentences.en: Tony then decided to take matters into his own hands.
sentences.zh: 托尼于是决定亲自采取行动。

sentences.en: He began writing letters to the Department of Public Prosecutions, urging them to charge Geoffrey for the murders of Helen and Stephen Gillum.
sentences.zh: 他开始向公共检察署写信，敦促他们以谋杀海伦和斯蒂芬·吉拉姆的罪名起诉杰弗里。

sentences.en: The DPP refused, citing a lack of evidence.
sentences.zh: 检察署以证据不足为由再次拒绝。

sentences.en: Tony began reaching out to journalists and other members of law enforcement trying to raise awareness to the situation in any way possible.
sentences.zh: 托尼开始联系记者和其他执法人员，试图以各种可能的方式提高公众对这一局面的关注。

sentences.en: Eventually, his story caught the attention of the production team at the Channel 9 television program
sentences.zh: 最终，他的故事引起了九号台电视节目制作团队的注意，

sentences.en: 60 Minutes, who launched their own investigation.
sentences.zh: 即《60分钟》栏目，他们随即展开了独立调查。

sentences.en: Stephen's mother,
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬的母亲、

sentences.en: Jessie, told 60 Minutes she didn't believe
sentences.zh: 杰西告诉《60分钟》，她根本不相信

sentences.en: Christopher Gillum played a role in the murders at all.
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗·吉拉姆在谋杀案中扮演了任何角色。

sentences.en: She described him as a lovely chap with a beautiful personality who had no malice and was bullied by his younger brother.
sentences.zh: 她将他形容为一个可爱的小伙子，性格甜美，没有任何恶意，并且常常受到他弟弟的欺负。

sentences.en: Jessie recalled,
sentences.zh: 杰西回忆说：

sentences.en: Geoffrey could never walk past Christopher without thumping him.
sentences.zh: “杰弗里路过克里斯托弗身边时总是忍不住要揍他。”

sentences.en: They always did it.
sentences.zh: “他们一直都这样。”

sentences.en: It was just a known thing.
sentences.zh: “这几乎是人尽皆知的事情。”

sentences.en: I don't think they liked each other at all.
sentences.zh: “我一点也不觉得他们互相喜欢对方。”

sentences.en: I really don't.
sentences.zh: “我是真的这么觉得。”

sentences.en: Neighbour Ted Warner expressed his disbelief about Geoffrey's story too, saying,
sentences.zh: 邻居泰德·华纳也表达了他对杰弗里说辞的不信，他说道：

sentences.en: To have two homicidal maniacs kind of crack out of their egg in the one night in the one home in the one suburb is pretty scary stuff.
sentences.zh: “在同一个晚上的同一个家庭、同一个郊区里，居然能冒出两个杀人狂魔，这实在是挺吓人的事。”

sentences.en: In Geoffrey's version of events,
sentences.zh: 在杰弗里对事件的描述中，

sentences.en: Christopher had lit his mother's body on fire and the house had blazed from there.
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗点燃了他母亲的尸体，大火随之蔓延开来。

sentences.en: But 60 Minutes had four separate arson investigators look into the case and they found evidence to indicate that the fire had actually started in the main bedroom
sentences.zh: 但《60分钟》节目组请来四位独立的纵火调查员对该案进行了调查，他们发现证据表明火灾实际上是从主卧室开始的

sentences.en: near Stephen Gillum's body, thus creating further doubts about
sentences.zh: 在斯蒂芬·吉勒姆的尸体附近，从而对

sentences.en: Geoffrey's story.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里的说法产生了进一步的怀疑。

sentences.en: They also consulted a leading criminal barrister who raised questions about Geoffrey's timing of the events.
sentences.zh: 他们还咨询了一位知名的刑事大律师，他对杰弗里事件发生的时间顺序提出了质疑。

sentences.en: Geoffrey had told the police that approximately
sentences.zh: 杰弗里曾向警方供述，大约

sentences.en: 90 seconds had passed between him hearing his mother screaming for help on the intercom, racing upstairs to the lounge room and witnessing
sentences.zh: 在他通过对讲机听到母亲呼救、冲上楼来到起居室并亲眼目睹

sentences.en: Christopher light her body on fire.
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗点燃她尸体的过程之间，过去了90秒。

sentences.en: If this was correct, it gave Christopher just 90 seconds to stab Helen
sentences.zh: 如果这是真的，这就只给了克里斯托弗90秒的时间来刺杀海伦

sentences.en: 17 times before running around the house pouring out mineral turpentine in preparation for the fire before Geoffrey arrived.
sentences.zh: 17刀，然后在杰弗里到达之前，在屋里四处泼洒矿物松节油为纵火做准备。

sentences.en: The 60 Minutes team reached out to renowned
sentences.zh: 《60分钟》团队联系了著名的

sentences.en: New South Wales forensic pathologist
sentences.zh: 新南威尔士州法医病理学家

sentences.en: Dr Godfrey Oakley to examine the case on their behalf.
sentences.zh: 戈弗雷·奥克利博士，请他代表他们检查此案。

sentences.en: After reviewing the crime scene photos and autopsy reports,
sentences.zh: 在审查了犯罪现场照片和尸检报告后，

sentences.en: Dr Oakley raised some questions about the lack of blood on Christopher's body.
sentences.zh: 奥克利博士对克里斯托弗尸体上没有血迹一事提出了一些疑问。

sentences.en: While the dressing gown he'd been wearing was soaked in blood from his own wounds, it was free of any blood spatter, as were his arms, legs and face.
sentences.zh: 虽然他穿着的晨衣上浸满了自己伤口流出的血，但上面没有任何血迹喷溅痕迹，他的手臂、腿和脸也是如此。

sentences.en: If Christopher had been the one to attack his parents,
sentences.zh: 如果袭击他父母的人是克里斯托弗，

sentences.en: Dr Oakley expected that his whole body would be splattered with blood.
sentences.zh: 奥克利博士预计他的全身都会溅满血迹。

sentences.en: Only a few drops were visible on his neck and chin and forensic experts agreed this could have come from his own wounds.
sentences.zh: 他的脖子和下巴上只有几滴可见的血迹，法医专家一致认为这可能是他自己的伤口流出的。

sentences.en: Looking at the crime scene photos,
sentences.zh: 通过查看犯罪现场照片，

sentences.en: Dr Oakley noted that the knife was lying underneath
sentences.zh: 奥克利博士指出，那把刀正压在

sentences.en: Christopher's left arm.
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗的左臂下方。

sentences.en: This positioning, coupled with the fact that there was no blood or fingerprints on the knife, led Dr Oakley to conclude that the knife had likely been washed and then placed there.
sentences.zh: 这种摆放位置，再加上刀上没有血迹或指纹这一事实，使奥克利博士断定这把刀很可能是被清洗过然后才放在那里的。

sentences.en: As for the lack of blood found on Jeffrey Gillum,
sentences.zh: 至于杰弗里·吉勒姆身上缺乏血迹的情况，

sentences.en: Dr Oakley reasoned this could only be explained by an attempt at cleaning himself or having been in contact with water.
sentences.zh: 奥克利博士推断，这只能用他曾试图清洗自己或接触过水来解释。

sentences.en: Asked if he thought the crime had been committed by one killer or two,
sentences.zh: 当被问及他认为这起犯罪是一个凶手还是两个凶手所为时，

sentences.en: Dr Oakley said, I think the probability is that there was one killer.
sentences.zh: 奥克利博士说：“我认为凶手为一人的可能性很大。”

sentences.en: I think it's reasonably probable and I don't think it is reasonably probable that two people killed in exactly the same way.
sentences.zh: “我认为这具有相当大的可能性，而且我不认为两个人以完全相同的方式行凶具有合理的可能性。”

sentences.en: I think that the evidence which was shown on the dead brother demonstrated that he wasn't involved.
sentences.zh: “我认为死去的兄弟身上显示的证据表明他没有参与。”

sentences.en: I think that he wasn't part of it.
sentences.zh: “我认为他不是同谋。”

sentences.en: Jeffrey declined to be interviewed for the program.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里拒绝接受该节目的采访。

sentences.en: Without his explanation for all of the evidence 60

sentences.zh: 主审侦探向雪莉·盖尔笃定地表示，这是一起仇恨犯罪。

28日星期六清晨，吉拉姆家中发生的事情有了更清晰的还原。

sentences.zh: 在过去的几个星期里，杰弗里·吉拉姆一直向朋友和女友表达对克里斯托弗行为的担忧，这实际上是在为他

sentences.en: At home, the unexpected visit from his girlfriend Hayley gave
sentences.zh: 在家中，女友海莉的意外造访

sentences.en: Jeffrey one final chance to proclaim Christopher's so-called psycho behaviour.
sentences.zh: 给了杰弗里最后一次机会，来宣称克里斯托弗所谓的精神病行为。

sentences.en: After Hayley left, Jeffrey then waited in the main house until his family was asleep before creeping into his parents' bedroom shortly before
sentences.zh: 海莉离开后，杰弗里便留在主屋里，直到全家人都睡着了，然后在

sentences.zh: 凌晨4点前不久潜入父母的卧室。

sentences.en: He brought an axe with him as backup just in case the stabbing was unsuccessful or in case Christopher heard the struggle and came to interfere.
sentences.zh: 他随身带了一把斧头作为后备，以防刺杀失败，或者克里斯托弗听到挣扎声前来干预。

sentences.en: The position of Stephen's body next to the bed and the lack of any defensive wounds indicated that he'd been stabbed while he was still asleep.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬倒在床边的位置以及身上没有任何防卫伤，表明他在睡梦中就被刺伤了。

sentences.en: The location of Helen's body indicated she had only managed to move a short distance from the bedroom to the lounge room before she too was attacked.
sentences.zh: 海伦尸体的位置表明，她在遭到袭击前，勉强只从卧室移动到了休息室一小段距离。

sentences.en: Once he had killed his parents, Jeffrey went down to kill Christopher, only to find him already coming up the stairs.
sentences.zh: 一旦杀害了父母，杰弗里就会下楼去杀克里斯托弗，结果却发现他已经走上楼来。

sentences.en: Seeing Jeffrey, Christopher immediately retreated back down, where Jeffrey launched his third fatal attack.
sentences.zh: 看到杰弗里，克里斯托弗立刻退回楼下，杰弗里在那里发动了第三次致命袭击。

sentences.en: Afterwards, Jeffrey showered, cleaned the knife and planted the panadol paste and associated items in Christopher's laundry basket to make it look like his brother had
sentences.zh: 事后，杰弗里冲了个澡，洗干净凶器，并将扑热息痛药膏及相关物品放在克里斯托弗的洗衣篮里，伪造出他哥哥在

sentences.en: intended to take his own life after committing the murders.
sentences.zh: 行凶后企图自杀的假象。

sentences.en: Jeffrey then attempted to siphon petrol from his car to use as an accelerant, but finding this too hard, he grabbed some mineral turpentine instead.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里随后试图用管子从自己车里抽汽油作为助燃剂，但发现太难了，于是改用了一些矿物松节油。

sentences.en: He doused the bodies of his mother and father to destroy any evidence and then set them alight.
sentences.zh: 他把父母的尸体泼上液体以销毁所有证据，然后纵火焚烧。

sentences.en: When Jeffrey arrived at the
sentences.zh: 当杰弗里来到隔壁

sentences.zh: 华纳家时，他们注意到他呼吸并不急促，而且摸上去身体是冰冷的。

sentences.en: Yet, in the recording of his triple zero call made from the Warner's phone,
sentences.zh: 然而，在他用华纳的电话拨打紧急求救电话的录音中，

sentences.en: Jeffrey sounded breathless as he spoke to the operator.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里和接线员说话时听起来气喘吁吁。

sentences.en: To the police, this indicated that Jeffrey had likely waited outside to make sure the fire had really taken hold before going next door to raise the alarm.
sentences.zh: 在警方看来，这表明杰弗里很可能在屋外等待，确保火势真正蔓延开来后，才去隔壁报警。

sentences.en: He feigned breathlessness on the triple zero call to make it look like he had immediately ran from the blazing house to call for help.
sentences.zh: 他在求救电话中伪装出气喘吁吁的样子，是为了伪造自己从烈火熊熊的屋子里立刻逃出来求救的假象。

sentences.en: He then tried to prevent one of the first responders from fighting the fire by saying someone in the house had a knife.
sentences.zh: 随后，他试图通过声称屋里有人拿着刀，来阻止第一批救援人员去灭火。

sentences.en: While Jeffrey's story had remained mostly unchanged, there were some small discrepancies.
sentences.zh: 尽管杰弗里的说法基本没变，但还是存在一些微小的出入。

sentences.en: When he called triple zero, he told the operator that when he first went upstairs after hearing his mother's cries for help, his brother was standing there with a knife.
sentences.zh: 当他拨打求救电话时，他告诉接线员，当他听到母亲的呼救声第一次上楼时，他哥哥正拿着一把刀站在那里。

sentences.en: He told the same thing to a detective on the scene.
sentences.zh: 他对现场的一名侦探也是这么说的。

sentences.en: However, during his police interview and a subsequent video walkthrough of the crime scene,
sentences.zh: 然而，在警方审讯以及随后的犯罪现场视频指认中，

sentences.en: Jeffrey claimed the knife had been on the floor near the piano.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里改口称刀一直在钢琴附近的地上。

sentences.en: Then there was the matter of Jeffrey's keys, which had been found on a table near the glass sliding doors upstairs.
sentences.zh: 还有杰弗里的钥匙问题，这些钥匙是在楼上玻璃滑门附近的一张桌子上被发现的。

sentences.en: In the video walkthrough of the crime scene,
sentences.zh: 在犯罪现场的视频指认中，

sentences.en: Jeffrey initially told the police that upon hearing his mother's screams, he'd locked the boathouse behind him out of habit and had placed the keys in his pocket.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里最初告诉警方，听到母亲的尖叫声后，他出于习惯把身后的船坞锁上了，并把钥匙放进了口袋。

sentences.en: When shown the keys on the table, he said he must have placed them there upon entering the house, but had no memory of doing so.
sentences.zh: 当看到桌上的钥匙时，他说自己进屋时一定顺手放在那儿了，但完全记不清了。

sentences.en: The police found this hard to believe.
sentences.zh: 警方觉得这很难让人相信。

sentences.en: If he really had walked in on Christopher about to set their mother's dead body on fire, surely the keys would be the last thing on his mind.
sentences.zh: 如果他真的撞见克里斯托弗正准备火化母亲的尸体，钥匙绝对是他脑子里最不会惦记的东西。

sentences.en: They thought it was more likely that the keys were on the table because Jeffrey had stayed in the main house all night and had never even gone down to the boat shed at all.
sentences.zh: 他们认为更可能的情况是，钥匙之所以在桌上，是因为杰弗里整晚都呆在主屋里，根本就没有去过船坞。

sentences.en: Speaking about the case to ABC's Australian story,
sentences.zh: 在接受美国广播公司（ABC）“澳大利亚故事”栏目采访时，

sentences.en: Tony Gillum explained,
sentences.zh: 托尼·吉拉姆解释说：

sentences.en: Jeffrey's story was fanciful.
sentences.zh: “杰弗里的说法纯属虚构。”

sentences.en: We know neighbours heard guttural screams before 4am.
sentences.zh: “我们知道邻居们在凌晨4点之前就听到了粗重沙哑的尖叫声。”

sentences.en: That was when the murders were taking place.
sentences.zh: “那就是谋杀发生的时间。”

sentences.en: The triple zero call was made at 4.34am.
sentences.zh: “求救电话是在凌晨4点34分打出的。”

sentences.en: For Jeffrey's story to be true, his mother would have had at least been alive for 20 minutes before making a call over the intercom to Jeffrey in the boat shed
sentences.zh: “要让杰弗里的说法成立，他的母亲身上带着重伤，至少要在通过内部对讲机给船坞里的杰弗里打电话之前活了20分钟。”

sentences.en: with serious stab wounds to herself.
sentences.zh: “得了吧，我觉得绝无可能。”

sentences.en: Now, I don't think so.
sentences.zh: “现在，我不这么认为。”

sentences.en: In 2005, the Homicide Squad submitted a brief of evidence to the Department of Public Prosecutions to see if they had sufficient evidence to charge Jeffrey
sentences.zh: 2005年，凶杀组向公共检控署提交了一份证据摘要，以评估是否有足够证据指控杰弗里

sentences.en: for the murders of Helen and Stephen Gillum.
sentences.zh: 谋杀海伦和斯蒂芬·吉拉姆。

sentences.en: The DPP not only went ahead with the charges, but served Jeffrey with an ex officio indictment, meaning that the case would go to trial without the need for a committal hearing.
sentences.zh: 检控署不仅推进了指控，还向杰弗里送达了直接起诉书，这意味着案件无需经过初审聆讯即可直接进入审判程序。

sentences.en: By this point, Jeffrey had married his girlfriend Rebecca and the two had one young daughter and another on the way.
sentences.zh: 此时，杰弗里已经娶了女友丽贝卡，两人育有一个幼女，第二个孩子也即将出生。

sentences.en: He requested a stay on the indictment, arguing that a trial would be oppressive, unfair, or in breach of the rule against double jeopardy.
sentences.zh: 他申请中止起诉，辩称审判将是苛刻的、不公正的，或者违反了禁止双重审判的原则。

sentences.en: The request was rejected and the trial went ahead in February 2008.
sentences.zh: 该请求被驳回，审判于2008年2月正式开庭。

sentences.en: The prosecution's case was that Jeffrey Gillum had been financially motivated to kill his parents and then frame his brother for the crime.
sentences.zh: 检方的核心论点是，杰弗里·吉拉姆因谋财害命杀害父母，然后将罪名嫁祸给弟弟。

sentences.en: They presented witnesses who testified to Christopher's good character.
sentences.zh: 他们出示了证明克里斯托弗人品极佳的证人证言。

sentences.en: None of them had ever seen him act aggressively towards his father or anyone else for that matter.
sentences.zh: 没有人见过他对父亲或任何其他人表现出攻击性。

sentences.en: Christopher's ex-girlfriend spoke about him with a genuine affection, describing him as a gentle person who didn't have a hostile bone in his body.
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗的前女友带着真挚的情感谈论他，形容他是一个温和的人，身上没有一丝敌意。

sentences.en: Nobody close to Christopher could imagine him fighting with his parents over money, particularly for the purpose of buying a car.
sentences.zh: 任何接近克里斯托弗的人都无法想象他会为了钱与父母争吵，尤其是为了买车这种事。

sentences.en: The prosecution submitted that Christopher couldn't have pulled off the attack without his glasses on.
sentences.zh: 检方辩称，克里斯托弗不戴眼镜根本无法完成这场袭击。

sentences.en: Furthermore, video demonstrations were presented by a fire expert who said that if the fire had been started by Christopher, like Jeffrey claimed, it would have started out small,
sentences.zh: 此外，消防专家出示了视频演示并指出，如果火灾是由克里斯托弗点燃的（正如杰弗里所说），火势最初应该很小、

sentences.en: slow-moving, and easy to put out.
sentences.zh: 蔓延缓慢且易于扑灭。

sentences.en: Jeffrey would have had 10 to 15 seconds to try and stop it, yet in his version of events, he did nothing.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里本有10到15秒的时间去试图阻止它，但在他的叙述中，他什么都没做。

sentences.en: The prosecution told the jury,
sentences.zh: 检方对陪审团说：

sentences.en: Jeffrey didn't do a thing to try to stop that fire, and that's not what an innocent man, a man who had not killed his parents, would do in those circumstances.
sentences.zh: “杰弗里什么都没做，试图阻止那场大火，一个无辜的人——一个没有杀害父母的人——在那种情况下是绝不会这么做的。”

sentences.en: They also presented testimony from various experts who said that it was very rare to see such a high number of stab wounds on all three victims, particularly when the wounds
sentences.zh: 他们还出示了多位专家的证词，称在所有三名受害者身上看到如此高数量的刺伤非常罕见，尤其是当这些伤口

sentences.en: were concentrated on the chests with none to the abdomen.
sentences.zh: 集中在胸部而腹部毫无伤痕时更是如此。

sentences.en: One expert noted a distinct pattern of injury in each of the victims that implied there was only one perpetrator.
sentences.zh: 一位专家指出，每个受害者身上都有明显的伤情模式，这暗示凶手只有一人。

sentences.en: The prosecutor told the jury that the similarities in the stab wounds were so remarkable that it defied logic to believe that two brothers independently got into a homicidal rage
sentences.zh: 检方告诉陪审团，这些刺伤的相似之处如此惊人，以至于如果相信两个兄弟会各自陷入杀戮狂潮，

sentences.en: using the same knife in the same way.
sentences.zh: 并且用同一把凶器以同一种方式行凶，那就太违背逻辑了。

sentences.en: But the defence posited that the events had played out exactly like Jeffrey Gillum had always maintained.
sentences.zh: 但辩方提出，事情的经过完全如杰弗里·吉拉姆一直坚称的那样发展。

sentences.en: They said the evidence didn't suggest this was a carefully planned crime, but a frenzied attack committed by a deranged individual as the result of a spur-of-the-moment
sentences.zh: 他们表示，证据并不表明这是一起精心策划的犯罪，而是一个精神失常的个人因一时冲动的

sentences.en: emotional or psychiatric disturbance.
sentences.zh: 情感或精神紊乱而实施的疯狂袭击。

sentences.en: With Christopher becoming increasingly withdrawn in the months leading up to the murders, they put it to the jury that the person more likely to have snapped that morning
sentences.zh: 鉴于克里斯托弗在谋杀发生前的几个月里日益孤僻，他们向陪审团暗示，那天早上最容易情绪崩溃的人

sentences.en: was Christopher.
sentences.zh: 其实是克里斯托弗。

sentences.en: The fact that Christopher's glasses were in the bathroom wasn't a tactical move by Jeffrey, but indicated that it was actually Christopher who had taken a shower
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗的眼镜在浴室里，这并不是杰弗里的战术安排，而是表明实际上是克里斯托弗在杀死父母后

sentences.en: after killing his parents.
sentences.zh: 冲了个澡。

sentences.en: In one of the crime scene photos, it appeared as though Christopher had a soap bubble in his ear and a towel with his name monogrammed onto it was also found rolled up
sentences.zh: 在一张现场照片中，克里斯托弗的耳朵上似乎挂着一个肥皂泡，他的卧室里还发现了一条绣有他名字缩写的毛巾被揉成

sentences.en: into a ball in his bedroom.
sentences.zh: 一团。

sentences.en: This suggested that Christopher had stabbed his parents and then gone downstairs to shower under the assumption they were both dead.
sentences.zh: 这表明克里斯托弗在刺死父母后，误以为两人都已死亡，于是下楼洗澡。

sentences.en: It was only when he heard his mother screaming for help on the intercom that he realised she was still alive.
sentences.zh: 直到通过对讲机听到母亲尖叫求救，他才意识到她还活着。

sentences.en: He quickly threw on his dressing gown and raced upstairs to stab her repeatedly in the back just seconds before Jeffrey arrived.
sentences.zh: 他匆忙套上晨衣冲上楼，在杰弗里赶到前几秒钟，疯狂地朝她背部猛刺。

sentences.en: Christopher's ophthalmic surgeon testified that while Christopher's uncorrected vision was below average and he certainly would have benefited from wearing his glasses,
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗的眼科医生作证说，虽然克里斯托弗不戴矫正镜片的视力低于平均水平，他确实戴眼镜会更好，

sentences.en: he would have been able to negotiate a familiar environment and perform everyday tasks quite well without them.
sentences.zh: 但他在熟悉的环境中完全能够行动自如，并且不戴眼镜也能把日常事情做得很好。

sentences.en: The surgeon felt that Christopher would have been capable of going upstairs, taking a knife out of a cutlery drawer and distinguishing between his mother and father.
sentences.zh: 这位医生认为，克里斯托弗完全有能力上楼、从餐具抽屉里拿出一把刀，并分清他的父亲和母亲。

sentences.en: The defence said that any similarities in the stab wounds was pure coincidence.
sentences.zh: 辩方表示，刺伤痕迹的任何相似之处纯属巧合。

sentences.en: If Helen's blood was on Jeffrey's feet, this was simply because he had come into contact with her blood when standing alongside her body.
sentences.zh: 如果海伦的血沾在杰弗里的脚上，那纯粹是因为他站在她的尸体旁时接触到了她的血。

sentences.en: A blood spatter expert also said it was possible that Jeffrey had brushed against something that was soaked in Helen's blood or that a drop of her blood had fallen from the knife
sentences.zh: 血迹喷溅专家还表示，杰弗里可能擦到了浸透海伦血液的东西，或者在她拿起凶器时

sentences.en: when he picked it up.
sentences.zh: 有一滴血从刀上滴落。

sentences.en: He also said it was possible the blood spatter on Christopher's neck and chin could have resulted from stabbing his parents.
sentences.zh: 他还表示，克里斯托弗颈部和下巴上的血迹可能是刺伤父母造成的。

sentences.en: As for the lack of blood or fingerprints on the knife, reports from first responders showed inconsistencies regarding the knife's original location.
sentences.zh: 至于刀上没有血迹或指纹，首批救援人员的报告显示，关于刀的原始位置存在前后矛盾的地方。

sentences.en: Some said it was lying on the floor, others said it was propped against Christopher's body.
sentences.zh: 有人说它躺在地上，也有人说它靠在克里斯托弗的尸体旁。

sentences.en: Approximately
sentences.zh: 在大约

sentences.en: 10,000 litres of water had been pumped into the upper level of the house during the firefighting efforts.
sentences.zh: 灭火过程中，有1万升水被泵入了房屋的上层。

sentences.en: Footage captured at the crime scene showed that Christopher's hair and body were wet and that water was dripping through the roof and down the staircase to the floor around him.
sentences.zh: 现场拍摄的画面显示，克里斯托弗的头发和身体都是湿的，水正顺着屋顶和楼梯流淌到他周围的地板上。

sentences.en: Any blood from the knife or on Christopher's body had likely washed off.
sentences.zh: 刀上的血迹或克里斯托弗身上的血迹很可能已经被冲洗掉了。

sentences.en: The knife was also handled extensively by the police using cloth and paper prior to it being tested for fingerprints.
sentences.zh: 在对这把刀进行指纹检测之前，警方也曾用布和纸对其进行了大量接触。

sentences.en: But according to one police expert, the material the knife handle was made of typically didn't show fingerprints anyway.
sentences.zh: 但据一位警方专家称，刀柄所用的材质本来就很难显现出指纹。
